entries.title: 邮件改得清楚礼貌自信
entries.summary: 把邮件改写得清晰、礼貌、自信，限120词内且不添加原意之外的内容。
entries.prompt: Rewrite this email to sound clear, polite and confident. Keep it under 120 words. Don’t add anything I didn’t say: [paste email]
entries.author: CopyPastePrompt

entries.title: 发送前检查邮件语气
entries.summary: 发重要邮件前，让AI扮演不高兴的收件人，找出可能被误读或反驳之处。
entries.prompt: Read this as the recipient who is annoyed with me. What would they misread or push back on?
entries.author: BongJupite43260

entries.title: 操作步骤改成新手版
entries.summary: 把流程步骤改写给新手：列前置条件、一步一动作、解释术语、标出缺失并给清单。
entries.prompt:
Rewrite these steps for a first-time user: [paste].

Keep the meaning.
List prerequisites before the first step.
Use one action per numbered step.
Explain unfamiliar terms.
Flag anything missing instead of inventing it.
Add a final checklist.

Then show which parts you changed and why.
entries.author: arnaud_azad
